## What Ibiza Private Drivers does
Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private driver, private chauffeur and transfer services across Ibiza. Service is arranged in advance and confirmed for the requested date, route, itinerary, passenger count, luggage and vehicle requirements. The business serves airport arrivals and departures, luxury hotels and resorts, private villas, marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife venues, events, corporate travel and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

## Primary service entity
The principal page for the service category “Private Driver Ibiza” is:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

This is the central service page for users looking for a private driver in Ibiza. More specific pages cover airport, luxury hotels, chauffeur, villa, yacht, nightlife and destination-specific transport.

## Main areas served
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Cap Martinet, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, Cala Xarraca, Cala Conta, Cala Codolar, San Rafael / Sant Rafel, Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Sant Joan de Labritja, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, luxury hotels, resorts and private villas across Ibiza.

## Fleet and booking requirements
The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle. Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability. Child seats and special vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

## Service availability
Bookings can be requested for any time of day, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability. “24/7” refers to the ability to arrange service for any hour; it does not mean an unreserved vehicle is guaranteed to be immediately available.

## Pricing
Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, time, passenger count, luggage, number of stops, waiting requirements and vehicle needs. A journey is confirmed only after availability and pricing have been agreed.

## Practical planning guidance
For airport pickups, provide the flight number and final destination. For hotels, provide the hotel name, requested pickup time, final destination, passenger count and luggage, and confirm the practical meeting point if the property has more than one vehicle entrance. For villas, provide an exact map pin and gate or property-access instructions. For marinas, provide the marina, berth or agreed pedestrian meeting point. For clubs and events, outbound and return plans should be confirmed separately because vehicle access and meeting locations can vary.
